title: Functional requirement set of the flying-fish analogue (Exocoetidae), at the level our annotations support
function: glides_over_water / enlarged_paired_pectoral_fins (the same source paper supplies both)
analogue: Exocoetidae (flying fishes), with the gliding halfbeaks as the second, independent glider in the same order
what_this_is: Every locus Daane 2021 reports as DIFFERING in flying fishes, turned into a requirement on a design. Sheet G is a per-site state requirement (a residue). Sheet I is a per-gene RATE requirement and has no state, so nothing a design does can be compared against it; it is kept because leaving it out would flatter the coverage number.
what_this_is_not: NOT the set of loci that differ in flying fishes. It is the set KNOWN to differ: 74 coding loci against the 23,611 predicted protein-coding genes of the Hirundichthys speculiger assembly (0.31 %).

NOT a causal set. Daane 2021 reports convergent substitutions and rate shifts; our own sequences/progression.json warns that tracking is not causing, and that the non-gliders score zero at these sites BY CONSTRUCTION.

NOT a non-coding requirement set. Sheets K and M (accelerated conserved non-coding elements) are GO-term enrichment tables with no gene column, so the regulatory requirements - which is where most between-species difference lives - cannot be enumerated at all. That is a named gap, not a zero.

sources.daane: Daane et al. 2021, Curr Biol, doi 10.1016/j.cub.2021.08.054, PMID 34534441, Data S1 (genotype/cache/daane2021_data_s1_mmc2.xlsx)

sources.orthologues: Ensembl REST /homology/id/<species>/<id>?target_species=danio_rerio;type=orthologues (Compara); one JSON per locus in C:/Temp/functional-cache/ortho/
sources.gene_universe: omics/genes.json (3,860 zebrafish genes; join key zfin_id)
